binary_record_layout.block_header: 24 bytes: little-endian REAL*8 VLO,VHI then INTEGER*4 LINES,NWDS
binary_record_layout.compiler_record_markers: GNU little-endian sequential-unformatted, leading/trailing 4-byte record byte counts
binary_record_layout.coupling_flag_field: IFLG per line, INTEGER*4; excluded from ordinary-field identity comparison

limitations: This is a structural/raw line-record comparison only; no absorption or radiance/flux calculation.
It does not validate all TAPE3 metadata semantics or optional extensions beyond this pinned GNU LNFL v3.2 layout.
The AER line data and generated TAPE3 are controlled research-use data; keep them private and do not redistribute.
scope: Compares valid ordinary line records in saved LNFL TAPE3 sequential-unformatted streams. It does not run LBLRTM, validate optical depth, or map line records to RRTMGP g-points.

source_semantics.Interpretation: Block boundaries/header counts and the file header can differ because coupled lines are removed. This check compares the ordered valid ordinary lines, preserving exact source-record bytes for every non-IFLG field; it does not assert TAPE3 files byte-identical.
source_semantics.bufout: Pinned util_gfortran.f90 BUFOUT writes unformatted IARRAY records (lines 262-278).
source_semantics.lnfl_instructions: NOCPL suppresses all line coupling information on TAPE3/TAPE7 (pinned documentation around lines 164-165).
source_semantics.lnfl_source: MOVE sets IFG2(I)=0 under NOCPL (lnfl.f:1068), then companion records are added only for IFG2(I)>=1 / ==5 (1084-1116); output block line count and records follow BLKOUT (1191-1196).
